data.name: Abzaari
data.gender_notes: Abzaari is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'abzara' which means 'father of the lion'. This name is a reminder of the courage and strength found in the hearts of those who believe in Allah. The name Abzaari conveys a sense of pride in one's heritage and a deep-rooted connection to the faith. The name Abzaari carries the meaning “Father of the Lion” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Abzaari usually hope their child will grow to embody father of the lion and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_urdu.name: عبدزاری

in_english.name: Abzaari
in_english.meaning: Abzaari means servant of Allah or worshipper
in_english.long_meaning: The name Abzaari originates from the Arabic root 'abd', which means servant or worshipper of Allah. This name is derived from the Quranic tradition of naming individuals with attributes of servitude to Allah, emphasizing the oneness of God and the individual's role as a devoted servant. Historically, names like Abzaari have been popular in Islamic cultures as they signify spiritual dedication and submission to Allah. The name carries a profound meaning of humility, devotion, and spiritual awareness.
